_readme: Per-machine lens declutter + ordering. Copy this file to config/lens_filter.json and edit that one (git-ignored, so a price-list update pulled from GitHub never overwrites your choices). FOUR settings: (1) 'keep_only' maps a lens category to the ranges to keep — within that category only lenses whose brand+name contains one of the snippets survive; a category you leave out is shown in full. (2) 'orderable_suppliers' + 'orderable_extra': lenses from other suppliers stay visible but greyed as 'no longer ordered' and are never the pick — 'orderable_extra' name snippets stay orderable regardless of supplier (MiyoSmart is still Hoya). (3) 'preferred' floats your everyday lenses to the top of the library with a star — 'match' order = priority, 'exclude' vetoes. All matching is case-insensitive substring on brand+name. Categories: Single vision, Progressive, Anti-fatigue, Occupational, Bifocal.
